Extremely disappointing customer support experience

I had an issue with a return pickup where the delivery agent incorrectly mapped two products against each other’s return requests. One refund was processed incorrectly, while the other refund of ₹983 remained pending.

I understand that operational mistakes can happen. What is unacceptable is how Myntra handles them afterwards.

I’ve contacted customer support multiple times through calls and chats, repeatedly explaining the same issue. Getting connected to an actual support representative is frustrating. The automated support system is inefficient, callbacks don’t work reliably, and some chat sessions are closed without any resolution.

I even escalated the issue to the Grievance Officer through email, but received no response. Eventually, I had to approach the National Consumer Helpline to get some attention to my complaint.

The most frustrating part is that the return deadline was approaching, and I was left chasing Myntra to correct an error that wasn’t mine.

A customer should not have to spend days explaining the same problem to different representatives just to get a basic return issue resolved.

Mistakes happen. But accountability and effective customer support should not be optional.

Myntra seriously needs to improve its customer grievance redressal process.

Extremely disappointed with Myntra’s service!

Myntra used to be one of my favourite shopping platforms, and the service was genuinely good earlier. Unfortunately, the quality of service has gone downhill.

I placed an order through Myntra Instant, which promises delivery within 30 minutes. However, even after waiting for more than 4 hours, my order was still not delivered. What made the experience worse was that I didn’t receive a single call or proper update from their side. There was absolutely no clarity about when my order would actually arrive. Eventually, I had no choice but to cancel it myself.

I had already paid through UPI, and I was informed that the refund would be credited today, but I am still waiting for my money.

To make matters worse, Myntra’s customer support is extremely disappointing. There is no easily accessible customer care number where you can directly speak to a real person. Their helplines mostly lead to automated computerised voice responses, which are of no help when you have an urgent issue. Customers are left with no proper assistance when they actually need support.

Customers should not have to chase a company for basic updates, speak to automated systems repeatedly, or struggle to get their own money back.

A company as big as Myntra should provide reliable delivery, proper communication and accessible human customer support.

I have genuinely had much better experiences with Myntra in the past, but the service now is extremely disappointing. The company seriously needs to improve its delivery system, customer care and refund process.
